responsibility: This file contains core VMS target runtime-name and function-emission support used during code generation. Its main responsibility is to patch builtin/runtime identifiers by creating transparent aliases from standard C names to the VMS DECCRTL or DPML entry points according to a generated translation table and target options such as pointer size, malloc64, floating format, and long double size; it also provides the VMS function-section hook, and augments function start emission to publish debugger entry symbols and main-program flag symbols consumed by VMS startup code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the VMS target behavior declared elsewhere: unlike vms.h, which binds hooks and target macros, and vms.opt, which only defines the user-visible option flags, this source file contains the executable logic that applies those flags at compile time by rewriting builtin/runtime names, choosing VMS-specific aliases, and emitting debugger/main-entry symbols during function output.
